prompt: Create an original 180 second deep instrumental house instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: warm synth chords, four-on-floor drums, sub bass. Style: consistent dance groove, small filter movement, no large drop. Tempo approximately 112 BPM; G minor. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: An energetic and upbeat electronic track featuring a driving synth melody, pulsating bassline, and a steady electronic drum beat. The production is clean and polished, creating a positive and danceable atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首充满活力和乐观的电子音乐，以驱动的合成器旋律、脉动的低音线和稳定的电子鼓点为特色。制作干净精致，营造出积极和适合跳舞的氛围。
